**sdd/issue-576-archetypes/explore**

Full file: openspec/changes/issue-576-archetypes/explore.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-576, off main@4cde50e). M5 step B — the four archetypes on #312's port.

Key findings:
- The issue body's Measured state (12/08) is stale in brain's favor: roles/ exists, n=2, instructions in the contract, #552 CLOSED (output contract can be mechanical), first-party/ Adversary seed exists.
- **ADR-0023 does not exist AT ALL — not even a draft.** #312 closed without its doctrine. The port + archetypes have no signed ADR.
- Three genuinely new fields (archetype, escalation rule, output contract); writes/reads already spoken for — duplicating them is what the 2026-08-12 rescope forbids. Every contract labelled mechanical|doctrinal (#499).
- Standing debts retirable here: resolve-challenger.mjs:24 binding half (the last debt of its class), #754 (closes per roadmap S5).
- Projection: compileAgentsMd precedent (byte-deterministic + drift guard). Targets are AGENT PLATFORMS (claude .claude/agents/*.md, antigravity AGENTS.md section) — NOT the SDD_ENGINE frameworks, which DECLARE to the port (D6 vocabulary).
- jd-{judge-a,judge-b,fix-agent}.md live in ~/.claude/agents (outside the repo): two Adversaries + one Constructor.

Open maintainer questions: projection targets; ADR-0023 here (Ruta A) or own ticket; jd-* migrate or leave; resolve-challenger debt here or separate.
